name: xo-tag-automation
description: Tag-based VM automation for Xen Orchestra  Manage performance tiers, group and VM ACL assignment, based on existing tags and/or CSV import/export files.
author: john olsen

configurationSchema.description: IMPORTANT -- The 'Delete configuration' button resets all plugin settings to their defaults. It does not delete any VMs, tags, groups, resource sets, or CSV files on your NFS share. It is safe to use if you want to reset the plugin configuration.

tagSuffix.title: Tag Suffix
tagSuffix.description: Pool-specific suffix , for granular control by pool (e.g. -v for POOL-V, -1 for POOL-1). Leave blank for generic.

schedule.title: Enforcement Schedule
schedule.description: How often to run Performance, CSV Sync, and Permission Autopilot.

dryRun.title: Dry-Run / Export-CSV
dryRun.description: When ON: previews all changes without applying them AND exports a fresh copy of all VM metadata to your CSV file (NewTags and NewNotes columns will be blank and ready to fill in). Check XO logs for full dry-run output. Turn OFF to apply changes for real.

enablePerformance.title: Enable Performance Sync
enablePerformance.description: Apply CPU weights and IO priorities based on VM performance tier tags (0-core, 1-high, 2-normal, 3-low).

enablePermissions.title: Enable Permission Sync
enablePermissions.description: Tags ending in -Admin / -Operator / -Viewer trigger group creation and ACL assignments. IMPORTANT: Verify your NFS share is properly configured and secured before enabling.

enablePermissionAutopilot.title: Enable Permission Autopilot
enablePermissionAutopilot.description: Automatically assigns permissions and performance settings using CSV files stored on a secure NFS share: CURRENT-VMS.CSV – Contains existing VMs. To make changes, add performance and/or permission tags to the NewTags column. Changes are applied during the next Autopilot run. PRELOAD-VMS.CSV – Used to predefine settings for VMs being added or migrated to XCP-ng. Autopilot monitors for matching VM names and automatically applies the specified NewTags and Notes when the VM is detected, then adds the VM to current-vms.csv for ongoing management. Example: Set the NewTags value for VM My-VM1 to 2-normal-1;Dept1-Operator. On the next run, Autopilot will set the VM CPU weight to Normal and create (if needed) and assign the Dept1-Operator group with the appropriate VM permissions. IMPORTANT: Verify that your NFS share is properly configured and secured before enabling this feature. If you are not actively performing VM migrations or onboarding projects, Autopilot should be disabled until it is needed again.

nfsSharePath.title: NFS Share Path
nfsSharePath.description: Base path to your NFS share directory. All plugin files are managed here automatically: current-vms.csv, preload-vms.csv, logs/xo-tag-automation.log, logs/xo-tag-automation-summary.log, logs/daily-summary.log. Main log auto-rotates at 2MB (one backup kept as xo-tag-automation.log.1).

stalenessWarnDays.title: CSV Age Warning (days)
stalenessWarnDays.description: Warn in logs if current-vms.csv has not been exported in this many days.

lastDailySummary.title: Last Daily Summary (auto-updated at midnight)
lastDailySummary.description: Displays the most recent entry from daily-summary.log on your NFS share. Updated automatically at midnight each day. Shows total VM count and newly added VMs for that day. Use the getDailySummary apiMethod via xo-cli to view full history.
lastDailySummary.default: (not yet available -- will populate after first midnight run)

performanceTiers.title: Performance Tier Settings
performanceTiers.description: CPU weights and IO priorities per tier.
